function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH sales AS (
  SELECT period, sku, SUM(qty) AS qty_sold, SUM(revenue_cad) AS revenue
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line
  WHERE period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
  GROUP BY period, sku
),
cost AS (
  SELECT period, sku, SUM(qty) AS qty_purch, SUM(amount_cad) AS cost
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
  GROUP BY period, sku
)
SELECT s.period, s.sku, s.qty_sold, s.revenue,
       c.cost,
       s.revenue/s.qty_sold AS avg_price,
       c.cost/c.qty_purch AS avg_cost,
       (s.revenue/s.qty_sold) - (c.cost/c.qty_purch) AS unit_margin
FROM sales s
JOIN cost c ON s.period = c.period AND s.sku = c.sku
ORDER BY s.period, s.sku","purpose":"Compute per SKU period revenue, cost, avg price, avg cost, unit margin"}
